description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Construct token.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
